periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique, angled approximately 45 degrees downward and outward from the nasal bridge relative to the vertical facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a high length-to-width ratio along the dominant axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward taper, with the inferior boundary extending significantly below the horizontal centerline of the ocular region.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: High thickness, covering the entire shoulder area and transitioning into the forelimbs.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide separation across the crown, approximately 1.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Rounded, smooth convex curvature at the superior boundary.
